description: Internal light-service assembly/furniture workshop, not a smelter: sawtooth roof, loading portal, separate pedestrian entry, workbenches, guarded tooling and pallet storage.
origin: Centered X/Z footprint, support feet at y=0; at-grade entry uses habitat floor.
sourceFacts: Internal light-service industry includes personal goods, furniture and handicrafts.
The colony planning assumption for light service industry is 4 square metres per person; this is a colony-wide allocation, not a workshop footprint.
The heavy-industry extraction facility is outside the habitat, about 10 km south of the hub, to avoid pollution and isolate industrial accident risk.
That external extraction plant is remotely operated in vacuum, with small attached shirtsleeve maintenance spheres.
The external extraction plant has solar furnaces and a solar-powered 200 MW electrical station; this internal workshop does not represent it.
Architecture should facilitate pedestrian traffic and acoustically isolate residences from noisy commercial and service activities.
